WITH sales_by_period AS (
  SELECT 
      s.region,
      d.fiscal_year,
      ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3)
     OR (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3)
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND s.store_id NOT IN (129, 137)  -- Exclude non-lfl stores
    AND s.region != 'Capital Region'  -- Capital Region not in FY2024/25
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
  GROUP BY s.region, d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
    region,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) AS sales_q3_fy25_26,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END) AS sales_q3_fy24_25,

        100 * (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) 
              - MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END))
        / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END),
        1
    ) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM sales_by_period
GROUP BY region

WITH current_store_region AS (
  -- Get current region assignment for each store (for reporting)
  SELECT store_id, region
  FROM dim_store
  WHERE is_current = TRUE AND store_id < 900 AND store_id NOT IN (129, 137)
),
sales_current_q3 AS (
  -- Q3 FY2025/26 sales by current store region
  SELECT 
      csr.region,
      SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN current_store_region csr ON f.channel_code = 'ST' 
    AND csr.store_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT s2.store_id 
      FROM dim_store s2 
      WHERE s2.store_key = f.store_key
    )
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
  GROUP BY csr.region
),
sales_prior_q3 AS (
  -- Q3 FY2024/25 sales - need to match same stores as current period
  SELECT 
      s.region,
      SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND s.store_id < 900 
    AND s.store_id NOT IN (129, 137)
    AND s.store_id IN (101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111, 112, 113, 114, 
                       124, 125, 126, 127, 128, 130, 138, 131, 132, 133, 134, 135, 139,
                       115, 116, 117, 118, 119, 120, 121, 122, 123, 136)
  GROUP BY s.region
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(sc.region, sp.region) AS region,
    ROUND(COALESCE(sc.net_sales, 0), 2) AS sales_q3_fy25_26,
    ROUND(COALESCE(sp.net_sales, 0), 2) AS sales_q3_fy24_25,
    CASE 
      WHEN sp.net_sales IS NULL OR sp.net_sales = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(sc.net_sales, 0) - sp.net_sales) / sp.net_sales, 1)
    END AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM sales_current_q3 sc
FULL OUTER JOIN sales_prior_q3 sp ON sc.region = sp.region
ORDER BY region

WITH lfl_stores AS (
  -- Define like-for-like stores
  SELECT store_id, MAX(region) AS current_region
  FROM dim_store
  WHERE is_current = TRUE AND store_id < 900 AND store_id NOT IN (129, 137)
  GROUP BY store_id
),
q3_fy25_26_sales AS (
  SELECT 
      s.store_id,
      ds.region AS current_region,
      SUM(f.net_amount) AS sales_fy25_26
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN lfl_stores ds ON s.store_id = ds.store_id
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
  GROUP BY s.store_id, ds.current_region
),
q3_fy24_25_sales AS (
  SELECT 
      s.store_id,
      SUM(f.net_amount) AS sales_fy24_25
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN lfl_stores ls ON s.store_id = ls.store_id
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
  GROUP BY s.store_id
)
SELECT 
    q25.current_region AS region,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(q26.sales_fy25_26, 0)), 2) AS sales_q3_fy25_26,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(q25.sales_fy24_25, 0)), 2) AS sales_q3_fy24_25,
    CASE 
      WHEN SUM(COALESCE(q25.sales_fy24_25, 0)) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(COALESCE(q26.sales_fy25_26, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(q25.sales_fy24_25, 0))) 
                 / SUM(COALESCE(q25.sales_fy24_25, 0)), 1)
    END AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM q3_fy24_25_sales q25
LEFT JOIN q3_fy25_26_sales q26 ON q25.store_id = q26.store_id
GROUP BY q25.current_region
ORDER BY q25.current_region
